text:
Kathy owns the condominium outright by survivorship under the tenancy by the entirety created by Bill’s deed, and that gift stands regardless of the prenuptial agreement. The prenuptial agreement waives her pretermitted-spouse, elective-share, and homestead rights, so she takes nothing further from the probate estate. Tommy takes the pasture land under the will, and Tommy and Julie share all other assets equally.
CONFIDENCE: 88
